hero.title1: Software and AI that work in production.
hero.title2: Technical leadership, architecture and applied AI.
hero.lead: I've spent more than ten years leading technology teams. I design companies' architecture, custom software, integrations and AI, and I run the in-house development team that builds them.
hero.ai: Before choosing a technology I make sure I understand the problem, and I explain what I'm ruling out and why. I've applied AI to business processes and strategy since it became available.

stack.title: Tech stack, layer by layer
stack.intro: Frontend, backend, data, AI, operations and infrastructure: the layers I use to take a system to production. If your business already uses other tools, I connect to them.
stack.hint: Hover, focus with the keyboard or tap a technology to see which projects use it. Each project opens its page.
stack.techNoProjects: {{tech}} doesn't appear in these featured projects; it's part of my experience in other systems.

layers.ai: I wire AI and automation into the processes and systems your business already uses: chatbots, ERP and accounting integrations. Ambar, this site's AI assistant, answers questions about my projects and what I can do for your business.
layers.frontend: I build web apps with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and mobile apps with Expo.
layers.backend: I design the architecture and APIs that connect a company's systems, with the database, authentication and payments.
layers.tools: Tests, containers and deployment to ship every system to production and keep it running.
layers.infra: I run servers, networks and security across hybrid on-prem and cloud environments.

rvdesk.title: RVDesk
rvdesk.intro: RVDesk is a support and project-tracking SaaS, a product of my own built for other companies. Your customers' emails become tickets, get classified with AI, are quoted in Zoho Books and scheduled in Zoho Calendar.
rvdesk.flowIntro: This is how an email travels until it's handled; each step shows the stack layer that makes it possible.
rvdesk.flowLabel: Journey of an email in RVDesk

mail.title: An email comes in
mail.desc: The customer's email reaches RVDesk's inbound email service.

verify.title: The sender is verified
verify.desc: The message signature and sender are validated. If the sender isn't verified, the email is quarantined instead of creating a ticket.

ai.title: AI classifies it
ai.desc: An AI model classifies the email and reports its confidence level. It only runs in authorized workspaces and under a daily budget.

board.title: The ticket lands on the board
board.desc: The ticket appears on a kanban board. Isolation between customers is enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security (RLS).

quote.title: Quote in Zoho Books
quote.desc: The quote for the job is managed in Zoho Books.

visit.title: Visit in Zoho Calendar
visit.desc: The customer visit is scheduled in Zoho Calendar.

portal.title: The customer follows it in their portal
portal.desc: The customer checks the status of their request in a dedicated portal.

services.title: What I can do for your business
services.intro: Four ways to work together, from idea to production.

software.title: Architecture and custom software
software.desc: I design the architecture and build web and mobile apps, APIs and internal dashboards, all the way to production.
points: Web app with React and Next.js, and API with Node.js and PostgreSQL.
Mobile app with Expo when the case needs it.

ai.title: AI and automation applied to your business
ai.desc: First I define where AI helps your operation and where it doesn't. Then I integrate it and keep it under control.
points: Processes worth automating, prioritized by business impact.
Chatbots and automatic classification of emails or tickets, with a confidence level.
Usage and spending limits, so AI costs don't get out of hand.

infra.title: Infrastructure and operations
infra.desc: Servers, networks and security across hybrid, on-premises and cloud environments, so what gets built runs reliably.
points: Physical and virtual servers on Windows and Linux (VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox).
Backup and disaster recovery, Docker containers and deployment.

integrations.title: I connect to the system you already use
integrations.desc: I won't ask you to switch tools: I integrate what's new with what your business already has, so data stops being copied by hand.
points: Connection through REST APIs, SOAP or whatever channel each system offers.
Data kept in sync between systems, without copying it by hand.
End-to-end flow testing before going to production.

services.examples: Examples: Zoho, QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, ERP, payment gateways… and whichever ones your business already uses.

understand.title: Understand the business
understand.desc: I start with the problem and the result you expect, before choosing the technology.

design.title: Design the architecture
design.desc: I explain the decisions, the alternatives I ruled out and the risks of each path.

build.title: Build and connect
build.desc: I develop the software, integrations and AI on top of what you already use.

operate.title: Operate and improve
operate.desc: I leave the system stable in production, with metrics and continuous improvement.
